 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"influence"** means the capacity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something. (प्रभाव)

 
 
• **Example:** The influence of the new manager has led to great changes in the company.
 
 
 
• In this context, "influence" is used to indicate that the system (the deep depression) is expected to cause certain weather conditions, such as heavy to moderate rain.
 
 
• **Example:** Under the influence of the storm, there might be widespread disruption and heavy rainfall.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Toll **(क्षति): The extent of damage or loss resulting from something.

 
 
• **Example:** The toll from the earthquake was significant in terms of both lives and property.
 
 
 
• **Guidance **(मार्गदर्शन): Advice or information aimed at resolving a problem or difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** With proper guidance, he was able to choose the right career path.
 
 
 
• **Hospitality **(अतिथि-सत्कार): The friendly and generous reception and entertainment of guests, visitors, or strangers.
 
 
• **Example:** The locals are known for their warm hospitality.
